contract: Default production path remains the existing sequential SSD dispatch unless explicit v5 envs are set.
The v5 candidate must require an oracle env in prototype gates; requesting candidate without oracle should fail closed.
Sequential oracle, candidate output, and candidate state must use separate buffers initialized from the same snapshot.
rationale: No cross-contamination and no mutation of live state during comparison.

contract: On success, commit candidate buffers; on mismatch, error. Do not copy oracle buffers to make the request succeed.
rationale: No silent fallback or degraded contract.

contract: BF16 output compare is exact bit equality for all elements.
rationale: The existing sequential kernel is the current oracle.

contract: F32 state compare is exact bit equality for all elements.
rationale: The mismatch being fixed is two f32 bits; tolerance would hide the known bug.

contract: Row64/state0 and row82/state14 component probes must pass before full compare and before any long timing.
rationale: Finds the specific failure area cheaply.

contract: All buffer sizes and flat-coordinate decoding are derived from runtime `L`, `n_heads`, `head_dim`, `state_size`, `n_groups`, and `chunk_size`.
Only after full oracle pass: candidate output to `ssd_out`, candidate final state to live `ssm_state`, then continue Mamba2 norm/out-proj.
On failure, record first output mismatch, first state mismatch, max/mean errors, probe component deltas, cache/temp status, and source spans.
rationale: Maintains measurement integrity before any optimization timing.
